goal: Generate an illustration of a healing scene on a spring afternoon in Japan, suitable as the header image for a travel public account, with a calm and gentle atmosphere.

scene.location: A two-story cafe converted from a machiya near Gion, with washi paper curtains half-rolled up, showing new green ginkgo outside and a glimpse of a distant torii red pillar.
scene.season: Late spring in April, the tail end of the cherry blossom season, new leaves beginning to flourish
scene.time_of_day: Around 15:00 in the afternoon, diagonal sunlight beams filtering through wooden grids
scene.weather_or_mood: Mild Warmth, Drafty Air, Distant Hints of Occasional Bicycle Bells on the Street

subject.human_or_animal: A fictional young woman with long golden brown hair back view angle: loose golden long hair, wearing a mint green thin knitted sweater, sitting on a high stool by the window, hand resting on a warm glass teacup, looking out the window without turning back

items: Open novel and pencil on the lacquered wooden table
A triangular piece of wagashi on a small porcelain plate
Ferns sprouts in a small ceramic pot on the windowsill.

lighting.direction: Left front side light as the main, with a paper lamp from the right rear of the scene adding a warm shell light
lighting.color_temp: Intertwined gold and green, with warm gold as the main.

style.art_style: Digital watercolor + fine line cel shading outline.
style.rendering: Light grain, low saturation, with distinguishable page and wood grain.
style.color_palette: Matcha green, wood brown, washi paper white, light gold tips, gray-green outside the window

must_keep: The subject is a side-back view, does not provide a clear front face
Light direction is unified, window grid shadows fall on the table
avoid: More than five items on the table.
Recognizable brand logo or street photography sign with real lettering
Deliberately close to the portrait details of any specific real public figure
